stories.headline: David Jenkins Says DC & HBO’s ‘Booster Gold’ TV Series “Won’t Be Moving Forward” - Deadline
stories.summary: David Jenkins Says DC & HBO's 'Booster Gold' Series "Won't Be Moving Forward"
stories.why: A mid-tier DC character's HBO adaptation collapsing signals how quickly prestige streaming bets fail—this guy had a shot at the kind of property that could've aged well with this demo and it's just gone.

stories.headline: Cape Fear Goes Fully Off The Rails With A Bizarre, Bloody Finale — Grade The Series! - TVLine
stories.summary: Apple TV's Cape Fear saved its most ridiculous plot twists for last — read our finale recap, and grade it in our poll.
stories.why: Cape Fear jumping the shark with absurd twists is the death knell for prestige thriller reboots; if Apple can't execute a straightforward crime drama, it matters for what you're actually paying for on streaming.

stories.headline: Dermot Mulroney To Leave ‘Chicago Fire’ Early In Season 15 - Deadline
stories.summary: 'Chicago Fire' will say goodbye to Dermot Mulroney, who will exit the NBC firefighter series early in Season 15.
stories.why: Dermot Mulroney bailing early from a 15-season firefighter show that men 25-45 actually watch signals either behind-the-scenes decay or a star realizing the IP's window is closing.

stories.headline: 'Knots Landing's Donna Mills, 85, explains why she's joining OnlyFans - USA Today
stories.summary: Donna Mills explained that OnlyFans will allow her to share more moments from her daily life and engage with fans in a meaningful way.
stories.why: An 85-year-old actress moving to OnlyFans isn't quaint—it's the explicit endpoint of legacy media collapse, where even established names must chase direct-to-fan economics to stay relevant.

stories.headline: BTS Boycott the Grammys, But Will Other Artists Follow? - Rolling Stone
stories.summary: After the Grammys announced a Best Asian Pop category, BTS announced they won't submit their album. Will other artists follow their lead?
stories.why: BTS refusing to play Grammy politics over a patronizing 'Asian Pop' category shows how major artists are finally rejecting tokenization; this shifts power dynamics in how non-Western music gets valued.

stories.headline: Premature Evaluation: Ariana Grande 'petal' - Stereogum
stories.summary: I was worried about this one. On her endless, overlapping press tours to promote the Wicked movies, Ariana Grande seemed eager to leave pop-music royalty behind, to throw herself into the kind of the…
stories.why: Ariana Grande potentially pivoting away from pop-royalty status mid-career suggests either genuine artistic restlessness or a calculated rebrand—either way, it unsettles the certainty around which pop stars actually stay on top.

stories.headline: Priscilla Presley, 81, is ageless in head-to-toe red for rare event appearance - Page Six
stories.summary: The businesswoman stepped out for a party in Mallorca, Spain.
stories.why: A celebrity turning 81 still commanding pap shots in designer red is just lifestyle validation; completely irrelevant unless you care about aging narratives, which this demo largely doesn't.

stories.headline: North West’s Tour Is Canceled - The Cut
stories.summary: A few days before North West was supposed to make her big tour debut with 21-year-old rapper Molly Santana, both artists shared that they were calling it off.
stories.why: North West's tour cancellation matters because it's a celebrity kid's inflated debut imploding in real-time, revealing how social-media clout doesn't translate to actual ticket sales or touring infrastructure.
